subject.title: refactor(qqbot): adopt core typing keepalive loop with budget accounting intact

question: Should `createTypingKeepaliveLoop` become a supported public plugin SDK contract during the program's no-API-change mechanical-adoption phase?
rationale: The implementation is reusable, but repository policy makes public plugin SDK ownership a durable compatibility decision that code correctness alone cannot resolve.

options.title: Keep Phase 1 API-neutral
options.body: Remove the public export and defer QQ adoption until an internal or approved injected runtime seam is available.

options.title: Sponsor the public contract
options.body: Approve the export, document its lifecycle semantics, add direct SDK contract tests, and recalculate surface budgets on current main.

options.title: Defer the refactor
options.body: Retain QQ's local scheduler until the channel program reaches an explicitly API-changing phase.

recommendation.title: Keep Phase 1 API-neutral
recommendation.body: Remove the public export and defer QQ adoption until an internal or approved injected runtime seam is available.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked phased program and introduced both the shared helper and current QQ behavior.
